# TU Delft thesis template

This is a template for a (PdD) thesis following the [TU Delft corporate design](https://www.tudelft.nl/en/tu-delft-corporate-design) using Typst.
It used the font family [Roboto Slab](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto+Slab) and [Arial](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arial) or alternatively the Typst default font [Libertinus Serif](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Libertinus).

The template is made by the same authors as the [TU Delft dissertation and report templates found on Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com/edu/tudelft#templates).
The repository of the developers is <https://gitlab.com/novanext>

[The template itself](docs/thesis.pdf) gives a more thorough overview of the functionality
